slides.title: Example # 1: Solution

visualInspection.notes: All three graphs inspected. Temperature cold shoulder 60–65 then zero at 70; warm triangle 65,75,85; hot 75,85,95; very-hot rises 90–95. Humidity axis descends 100→40; very-humid shoulder 90–100 with zero at 70, humid triangle 40,60,90, dry shoulder 40–45 with zero at 50. Power axis descends 100→0: fast shoulder 80–100 zero at 50; medium 20,50,80; slow 0,20,50; off shoulder at 0 falling to zero at 20. Marked Hot 0.27 and Humid 0.65 disagree with exact straight-line interpolation at 78 and 70 (0.3 and 2/3); use stated grades separately. Actual 1800×1013 page pixels viewed alongside text.
